name: Sophie
source:
A virtuous, bright, and deeply religious girl-knight. She holds a deep respect and admiration for the pope, but he holds evil thoughts towards her, and offered her as a sacrifice when the King of Bugs requested reparations. Fastidious and has a hatred of bugs bordering on profound disgust. 

She is the daughter of a fallen noble family. She strives to clear her father's name, who died in disgrace. She is a good girl at heart, but stretches herself thin and uses harsh words at others as a first resort. She likes cute things and dreams of romance. Gets taken advantage of by adults due to her hard working nature.
